messages.content: You are planning a sequence of ordinary, mundane public social-media posts for one fictional author. You do not write the posts; you invent the concrete, small, specific everyday occasions behind them. Output strict JSON only.

Author profile:
- płeć gramatyczna: mężczyzna (formy męskie)
- zajęcie i rytm dnia: Jest na emeryturze w Pile; rano robi zakupy, a wpisy publikuje po południu.
- zainteresowania: karmniki dla ptaków, krzyżówki panoramiczne, naprawa lamp
- lokalny punkt odniesienia: warzywniak przy ulicy Bydgoskiej w Pile
- aktualna sytuacja życiowa: Odnawia lampę stojącą i zapisuje, co udaje mu się znaleźć na pobliskim targu.
- sposób pisania: zdania: medium; interpunkcja: poprawna i pełna; wielkie litery: standard; literówki: none; skróty: none; emoji: rare
- tik językowy: kończy „ot, taka obserwacja”

For each of the 13 topic prompts below, invent ONE concrete, specific, small occasion from this person's life that would make them post (not a generic statement about the topic: a particular thing that happened, with at most one small detail a real person would mention - sometimes a product name, sometimes a number or price, sometimes a place, occasionally a time; many occasions need no such detail at all). Vary mood (bored, amused, tired, pleased, mildly annoyed, neutral, curious), vary how the post starts (mid-thought, a question, a one-word reaction, a fact, a quote of what someone said), and decide whether the verbal tic appears (at most in a third of posts). Occasions must not involve conflict with identifiable people, politics, crime, security, violence, or protected characteristics.

Topic prompts:
1. jedzenie i gotowanie - śniadanie w biegu (morning commute, Monday)
2. komunikacja i dojazdy - remont drogi na trasie (early morning, Monday)
3. zakupy i ceny - zakupy na targu (lunch break, Monday)
4. praca i grafik - praca zdalna, domowe biuro (late night, Wednesday)
5. zwierzęta - weterynarz, szczepienie (evening, Wednesday)
6. zdrowie i sen - kawa i sen, ironicznie (evening, Monday)
7. gry i seriale - wieczór z planszówkami (evening, Monday)
8. pogoda - wiatr, burza (late night, Thursday)
9. zwierzęta - zwierzę zniszczyło coś (afternoon, Monday)
10. komunikacja i dojazdy - parking, brak miejsc (early morning, Friday)
11. jedzenie i gotowanie - kawa z nowego miejsca (evening, Friday)
12. zwierzęta - nowe zwierzę w domu (late night, Saturday)
13. zakupy i ceny - zakupy na targu (evening, Thursday)

Return a JSON array of 13 objects, in order, each with:
- "occasion": one or two sentences in Polish, concrete
- "mood": one word in English
- "opener": one of "mid-thought", "question", "one-word reaction", "plain fact", "reported speech", "complaint", "list of two things"
- "length_words": integer between 8 and 50, varied across the set (some very short)
- "tic_fires": true or false
